start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein se kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Board par dekho: Kabir, triangle ko aise sochiye: teen sides aur teen corners. Perimeter nikalne ke liye aap kya jodenge?

turns.line: board par rocket engine ka diagram banao
turns.reply: Kabir, rocket engine gol metal chamber jaisa hota hai, neeche nozzle; kuch seconds mein real picture aayegi. Bana sketch—kaunse parts dikh rahe hain?
Ab triangle par lautte hain: perimeter ke liye teenon sides ki lengths jodiye. Aap ek triangle banaakar uski sides ginenge?
